procedures.checklist_entry: Wings, tailplane (tail screw), and canopy securely installed
procedures.procedure_description: Verify both wings are fully inserted into the fuselage, wing spar is engaged, and all retention screws or clips are tight.

procedures.checklist_entry: Fuselage, wings, wing spar, and tail free of cracks, dents, warping
procedures.procedure_description: Perform a visual structural inspection of all airframe surfaces. Do not fly if any structural damage is found.

procedures.checklist_entry: External components mounted securely (GPS, telemetry antenna, camera)
procedures.procedure_description: Confirm all externally mounted components are secure, mounts are tight, and no parts protrude or could snag during flight.

procedures.checklist_entry: Wing servo connectors connected and strain-relieved
procedures.procedure_description: Verify each wing servo connector is fully seated, locked, and the cable is looped or secured to prevent accidental pull-out.

procedures.checklist_entry: Antenna position correct (telemetry, RC)
procedures.procedure_description: Check telemetry antenna is vertical and RC antenna is oriented per the pre-flight briefing for optimal RF performance.

procedures.checklist_entry: No pinched cables, exposed wires, or loose connectors
procedures.procedure_description: Trace all wiring runs and confirm no cables are trapped between panels, no insulation is damaged, and all connectors are fully mated.

procedures.checklist_entry: Battery installed for CG check (and payload if installed)
procedures.procedure_description: Insert the flight battery and any mission payload in their bays, then check the airframe balances at the specified CG point.

procedures.checklist_entry: CG within acceptable limits
procedures.procedure_description: Balance the aircraft on the CG reference marks. Adjust battery position forward or aft as required until CG is within published limits.

procedures.checklist_entry: Propeller free of cracks and deformation, mounted correctly
procedures.procedure_description: Inspect propeller blades for cracks, chips, or warping. Confirm the prop is correctly mounted on the motor shaft and the spinner or nut is tight.

procedures.checklist_entry: Motor mount secure, and spins smoothly
procedures.procedure_description: Attempt to twist the motor mount by hand. It must be completely rigid with no play or creaking.

procedures.checklist_entry: RC transmitter on
procedures.procedure_description: Power on the RC transmitter and confirm it is bound and showing the correct model profile before powering on the aircraft.

procedures.checklist_entry: GCS connected and telemetry link verified
procedures.procedure_description: Start the GCS software, confirm the aircraft appears on the map and telemetry parameters are being received.

procedures.checklist_entry: Aircraft powered on
procedures.procedure_description: Connect the flight battery or power switch and wait for autopilot initialisation to complete.

procedures.checklist_entry: No autopilot errors requiring calibration or setup (pre-arm checks clean)
procedures.procedure_description: Review the GCS HUD and message log for pre-arm warnings. Resolve all warnings before proceeding.

procedures.checklist_entry: Control surfaces centred at neutral
procedures.procedure_description: Visually confirm that elevator, rudder, and ailerons are at neutral (zero deflection) with transmitter sticks centred.

procedures.checklist_entry: Correct control direction in MANUAL and FBWA (elevator, rudder, ailerons)
procedures.procedure_description: In MANUAL mode: apply each stick input and confirm correct surface direction (pull back = elevator up; right rudder = rudder right; right stick = right aileron up / left aileron down). Then switch to FBWA: bank and pitch the airframe by hand and confirm the autopilot deflects surfaces to oppose the movement (roll right = left aileron up; pitch nose up = elevator down). Both checks must pass.

procedures.checklist_entry: Full and smooth deflection, no binding, no wobble
procedures.procedure_description: Sweep each surface through its full range. Movement must be smooth and meet deflection limits specified in the maintenance record.

procedures.checklist_entry: Apply firm hand pressure on each surface while servos powered to confirm no slipping linkages
procedures.procedure_description: With servos engaged, push firmly on each surface. Any movement indicates a slipping servo horn or loose linkage — must be corrected before flight.

procedures.checklist_entry: Throttle response verified with aircraft restrained and prop area clear
procedures.procedure_description: With the aircraft firmly restrained and all personnel clear of the propeller arc, briefly increase throttle to confirm motor and ESC respond correctly.

procedures.checklist_entry: GPS fix stable (target 10+ satellites) and home position set
procedures.procedure_description: Wait for GPS HDOP to settle and satellite count to reach 10 or more. Confirm the GCS shows the home position set at the launch point.

procedures.checklist_entry: RC RSSI and telemetry link quality acceptable (single combined 'links OK' check)
procedures.procedure_description: Check GCS link quality indicators and RC RSSI are within acceptable limits per SOP thresholds, with no dropouts observed.

procedures.checklist_entry: Flight modes correct and match the mission plan
procedures.procedure_description: Verify flight mode switch positions on the transmitter are programmed to the modes specified in the mission plan (e.g. AUTO, GUIDED, MANUAL).

procedures.checklist_entry: Failsafe actions confirmed (loss of C2 and loss of telemetry behaviour as intended)
procedures.procedure_description: Review GCS failsafe settings and confirm the aircraft will perform the planned failsafe action on loss of C2 link and on loss of telemetry, consistent with the approved OpSpec.

procedures.checklist_entry: Kill switch functional and tested (brief test, then reset)
procedures.procedure_description: Activate the kill switch briefly to confirm the motor disarms immediately. Reset and confirm normal arm state is restored before proceeding.
